easyPrerequisites: Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate The Flesh Is Weak by tapping it, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.
